notes.title: PATCH v1.34
notes.content:
Here's what's new:
[list]
[*] Fixed room-changing no clips bug
[*] More lag improvements
[*] Spectators now show up as grey in the player list
[*] Fixed a missing block
[*] If you are the only player in the server, you no longer are waiting as a spectator, you can roam the manor while waiting for players.
[/list]

[b]The master server list has been wiped so please restart your servers if you had one up.[/b]
